description: The learner already has common interview phrases; the run still adds useful new ones.
jobDescription: Marketing Coordinator. Plan campaigns, manage our social media calendar, and report on campaign results to the marketing manager.

sessions.advice: Keep the conversation going: ask a follow-up question and develop answers with an example.
corrections: I am work here since two years
I have worked here for two years

sessions.advice: Use the past simple consistently for finished actions.
corrections: yesterday we go to the client
yesterday we went to the client

practice.target: Could you tell me more about the team?
In my previous role I was responsible for social media.
